title: [Bug] `AttributeError: 'TeamRunOutput' object has no attribute 'event'` in team SSE streaming
author: phnmn

comments.author: phnmn
comments.body:
I've opened PR #8240 that provides a comprehensive fix for this issue, covering all 6 affected call sites (not just the team router):

**Changes in #8240:**

1. **Defensive check in `format_sse_event`** (`os/utils.py`): `getattr(event, "event", None) or "message"` — belt-and-suspenders protection against any accumulator reaching the formatter

2. **isinstance filtering in all 6 SSE router streamers**:
   - `teams/router.py`: `team_response_streamer` + `team_continue_response_streamer` → filter `TeamRunOutput`
   - `agents/router.py`: `agent_response_streamer` + `agent_continue_response_streamer` → filter `RunOutput`
   - `workflows/router.py`: `workflow_response_streamer` + `workflow_continue_response_streamer` → filter `WorkflowRunOutput`

3. **12 regression tests** across 3 test files (4 per router type)

The existing PR #8236 only fixes 2 of the 6 vulnerable call sites (team router only), missing the agent and workflow routers entirely. The same `.events` vs `.event` mismatch and accumulator leak exists in all 3 routers.
